method: Sequential capacity-leased builds in one clean source checkout, with separate initially empty targets and Kache runtime/configuration per source. Shared pinned Kache 1.2.1 object store; actual compiler units and frontend sections read from Cargo timing reports.
interpretation: Package wall time is effectively unchanged in this pair. The native compiler unit and its frontend section are smaller, while its later start offsets that difference. This first contract extraction establishes the lower crate and moves its tests; it does not establish a CI latency improvement.
limitations: One observation per source, before then after, on a shared host. Cache counts differ and this is not a controlled latency distribution.
The profile builds the native library and harn-test-echo-env, not the shared CLI producer or test units.
Transport, agent-session behavior, and most native LLM code remain above the new crate. The latest successful main merge-group p90 remains 1225 seconds against 600.
